title.en: Tampere crowdsourced, official split (697 train / 3,951 test scans), 3-D error
title.zh: Tampere 众包数据，官方划分（训练 697 / 测试 3,951 条），三维误差

dataset.name: tampere
dataset.citation: Lohan et al., Wi-Fi Crowdsourced Fingerprinting Dataset for Indoor Positioning, Data 2(4):32, 2017, doi:10.3390/data2040032

protocol.name: official
protocol.summary: the dataset's own train/test files (the setting of most published numbers)

skips.en: model-based: the dataset does not publish the access-point positions
skips.zh: 基于模型的方法：数据集未公开 AP 位置

notes.en: Positions are (x, y, z) with z the floor height (3.7 m per floor), so every error is the 3-D error of the dataset's benchmark software; floor accuracy is on floor = round(z / 3.7).
notes.zh: 位置为 (x, y, z)，z 为楼层高度（每层 3.7 m），因此误差均为数据集基准软件使用的三维误差；楼层准确率按 floor = round(z / 3.7) 计算。

cells.command: indoorloc benchmark --dataset tampere --protocol official --preprocess fill --method benchmarks.baselines:TrainingCentroid --seed 0 --no-download -q
indoorloc benchmark --dataset tampere --protocol official --preprocess fill --method knn --seed 0 --no-download -q
indoorloc benchmark --dataset tampere --protocol official --preprocess fill --method wknn --seed 0 --no-download -q
indoorloc benchmark --dataset tampere --protocol official --preprocess fill --method horus --seed 0 --no-download -q

display: ensemble: median of WKNN, RF, Horus

cells.command: indoorloc benchmark --dataset tampere --protocol official --preprocess fill --method mlp --seed 0 --no-download -q
indoorloc benchmark --dataset tampere --protocol official --preprocess fill --method svm --seed 0 --no-download -q

display: GP 无线电地图（逐楼层）

cells.command: indoorloc benchmark --dataset tampere --protocol official --preprocess positive --method wknn --seed 0 --no-download -q
indoorloc benchmark --dataset tampere --protocol official --preprocess exponential --method wknn --seed 0 --no-download -q
indoorloc benchmark --dataset tampere --protocol official --preprocess powed --method wknn --seed 0 --no-download -q
indoorloc benchmark --dataset tampere --protocol official --preprocess none --method horus --seed 0 --no-download -q

mean_error.definition: mean 2-D Euclidean distance between estimated and true positions, as reported (papers use the dataset's own coordinates)

floor_accuracy.definition: percentage of test samples whose floor is estimated correctly (floor hit rate)

building_accuracy.definition: percentage of test samples whose building is estimated correctly

literature.rule: shown: literature entries checked 'verified', 'corrected' or 'unchecked'; hidden: 'unidentified', 'missing' and numbers IndoorLoc 0.1 produced itself
